title: Database Report: Twin-2K-500: A Data Set for Building Digital Twins of over 2,000 People Based on Their Answers to over 500 Questions
authors: Olivier Toubia; George Gui; Tianyi Peng; Daniel J. Merlau; Ang Li; Haozhe Chen
eligible_reason: Database report: a public survey panel of 2,000+ respondents answering 500+ questions over four waves, used to build and evaluate LLM digital twins. Analyses are accuracy metrics and within/between-subject experiment comparisons (PanelOLS with respondent effects). No policy adoption or DiD.
design_notes: evaluation/within_between_subjects.py runs PanelOLS(y, X, entity_effects=True) for within-subject experimental manipulations; other scripts compute MAD accuracy of simulated responses.
data_files_note: Survey data downloaded from Hugging Face via script; pre-computed LLM simulation outputs shipped.
data_provenance_note: Public survey data set released by the authors. Moot (no DiD).
screener_notes: No article text or published PDF available at screening time (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked); screened from the package README, code, shipped data and the OpenAlex abstract. Title of package README/code matches the paper (no mismatch).
